sourceQuarantine: Opposing-roster register identity collisions are excluded before all fits.
unknownBatterSlot: Neutral middle-band prior; known players use training-window slot mixture, never future batting-order outcomes.
trainingWindows: Three completed calendar years ending before prediction year. Walk-forward uses earlier completed test years without retuning. Separate locked2022 fit predicts entire2023–2026 block.
features: Player/phase, opposing player/phase, competition/phase, venue/phase, year/phase, innings/phase, batting-slot band/phase. Context scales10/5/1/3/5/5 encode regularisation hierarchy, fixed before testing.
model: Weighted sparse Ridge on runs minus observational wicket cost, separate batter faced/bowler legal denominators; bowler charges exclude byes/legbyes/penalties.
selection: Minimise validation weighted per-ball squared utility error separately for each family. No test-period tuning.
promotion: Per-family walk-forward player-cluster97.5% bootstrap lower bound of Spearman gain must exceed0 and the fixed2022 whole-block test point gain must be nonnegative; no automatic inference of unidentifiable technique/mental/keeping attributes.
